name: postmark
label: Postmark
description: Transactional email platform for sending email, templates, and retrieving delivery and bounce insights.

token.label: Server API Token
token.description: Create or copy a Postmark Server API Token from Servers → API Tokens in Postmark.

send_email.label: Send Email
send_email.description: Send a single transactional email using Postmark.

from.label: From
from.description: Sender email address configured in Postmark.

to.label: To
to.description: Recipient email addresses, as a JSON list.

cc.label: CC
cc.description: Optional CC recipients, as a JSON list.

bcc.label: BCC
bcc.description: Optional BCC recipients, as a JSON list.

send_email_with_template.label: Send Email With Template
send_email_with_template.description: Send an email using a Postmark template ID and template model.

from.label: From
from.description: Sender email address configured in Postmark.

to.label: To
to.description: Recipient email addresses, as a JSON list.

cc.label: CC
cc.description: Optional CC recipients, as a JSON list.

bcc.label: BCC
bcc.description: Optional BCC recipients, as a JSON list.

templateModel.label: Template Model
templateModel.description: JSON object used to populate the Postmark template.

get_email_bounces.label: Get Email Bounces
get_email_bounces.description: List bounces from your Postmark server.

count.label: Count
count.description: Maximum number of bounces to return (max 500).

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of bounces to skip before returning results.

type.label: Type
type.description: Optional bounce type filter, for example HardBounce.

inactive.label: Inactive Only
inactive.description: Filter by inactive bounces only. When not set, both active and inactive bounces are returned.

emailFilter.label: Email Filter
emailFilter.description: Filter results by bounced recipient email address.

messageId.label: Message ID
messageId.description: Filter results by Postmark message ID.

get_delivery_stats.label: Get Delivery Stats
get_delivery_stats.description: Retrieve delivery statistics for the current Postmark server.
